# Section Q (EXPLORATORY): simple fixes for angled / low-resolution photos of a screen

*Generated by `scripts/analysis/section_Q_fixexp.py`. Rules fixed beforehand (docs/plan/analysis_plan_changes.md, 2026-11-10). 60 photos (30 pages x straight/angled), one phone, one screen. V0 = original photos (Section O). 'bad' = no usable heart rate or wrong (> 5 bpm, cleaned).*
